packageRules.description: Expo SDK is a coupled bundle (bundledNativeModules.json). Bump via a single SDK-upgrade story, not per-package — see epics.md Maintenance section M1.

Tamagui is a coupled compiler/runtime bundle across @tamagui/core, @tamagui/web, @tamagui/animations-*, @tamagui/babel-plugin, @tamagui/next-plugin, and the tamagui umbrella. Per-package bumps fragment the ecosystem (closed PR #34). Bump via a single Tamagui-upgrade story — see epics.md Maintenance section M2.
